column1: # Aggregated dataset: Continuous multi-span C and Z purlins with through-fastened panels under uplift

# Multi-span (mostly three-span) continuous lapped C and Z purlin assemblies with through-fastened panels tested to failure under chamber uplift; continuity over interior supports and the lapped splice make these a distinct population from simple-span tests.
